about: Seed library of history story topics. 'vidiq' topics come from vidIQ signals fetched 2026-11-22 (outliers, rising keywords, trending videos); 'evergreen' topics are curated. Scores are my 0-100 priority guess, not a vidIQ number. Topics are seeds: every fact must be checked before publishing. Titles rewritten on 2026-11-25 as curiosity questions (original in orig_title); ids unchanged so made-story tracking keeps working.
excluded_note: Skipped trending items that are pseudo-history or unverifiable (Tartaria, Anunnaki-as-aliens, 'forbidden' claims), music/exam/news content and non-story keywords.
